output.explanation: Expanded terminal-model vertically into a package-level center and two peripherals: retained screen storage and stream decoding/handler composition. Kept modular-core and surface-session unchanged because they already distinguish sibling packages from owned instances. Verified the pinned checkout, exports, ownership and consumer dependencies. Clarified that continuation tracking is optional and supported only by TerminalStream, that Stream owns its handler but borrows Terminal through it, and that RenderState.beginUpdate consumes terminal dirty state rather than merely reading it. Preserved all existing edges, updating terminal-model endpoints where concepts moved.

Ghostty's surface-centered core
|
|-- Hosting boundary [A] (App and apprt are sibling modules)
|   |-- App: shared application state
|   |   |-- Public: create/destroy, tick, addSurface/deleteSurface, updateConfig
|   |   |-- Retains: runtime-surface registry, focus, SharedGridSet, optional Device
|   |   |-- Public Message/Mailbox: cross-thread requests; tick drains on app thread
|   |   `-- -> Surface.handleMessage/performBindingAction; font and renderer resources
|   `-- apprt: compile-time host contract
|       |-- Public: App/Surface aliases, Action/Target, surface.Message/Mailbox
|       |-- Implementations: GTK/none (exe), embedded (lib), browser (wasm)
|       `-- Native UI/layout belongs to runtime/host, not the core Surface
|   Source: src/App.zig:22-78,164-198,504-537,563-613; src/apprt.zig:1-54
|
|-- Surface [S]: one terminal widget, not a window/tab/split manager
|   |-- Public lifecycle, event callbacks and action/message entry points

terminal [T]: semantics package and its consumer boundaries
|
|-- Terminal (public type)
|   |-- Public: init/deinit, print/printSlice, resize, vtStream/vtHandler
|   |-- Retains modes, colors, tabstops, cursor policy, dimensions, title/pwd
|   |-- screens: owned ScreenSet -> screen-storage expands retained instances
|   `-- -> decoding creates caller-owned streams; Terminal does not retain a parser
|   Source: src/terminal/Terminal.zig:45-143,344-430
|
|-- Stream decoding (sibling implementations, not children of Terminal)
|   |-- Public Stream(Handler), StreamAction, StreamBoundary and Parser
|   |-- TerminalStream = Stream(stream_terminal.Handler) -> stream-decoding
|   `-- -> Handler edits Terminal and its active Screen; effects are callbacks
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:48-66; stream_terminal.zig:31-99
|
|-- Protocol vocabulary (package siblings, not host policy)
|   |-- CSI/OSC/DCS/APC, modes/colors, reports, semantic prompts and Kitty types
|   `-- -> Used by terminal decoding/handlers and application-aware termio handler
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:1-86
|
|-- Public read models (consumers, not retained children of Terminal)
|   |-- Selection/SelectionGesture and formatter: tracking and text views
|   |-- search
|   |   |-- Public Active, PageList, Screen, Terminal and Viewport search types
|   |   |-- Private sliding-window machinery
|   |   `-- Thread only for Ghostty artifact; void in library build (xev dependency)
|   `-- RenderState (terminal/render.zig, NOT renderer.State)
|       |-- Retains incremental cells, selections and dirty regions
|       |-- beginUpdate captures Terminal and consumes dirty state under caller lock
|       |-- endUpdate finishes owned data without Terminal access; update does both
|       `-- -> renderer consumes snapshots; font shaping consumes snapshot cells
|   Source: src/terminal/search.zig:1-22; render.zig:289-338,905-966,1420-1423;
|           src/font/shape.zig:71-78
|
`-- Consumer boundary
    |-- termio owns live Terminal and a separate application-aware persistent stream
    |-- Surface uses modes, selections, formatter and optional search worker
    |-- renderer supplies synchronization; semantics require no PTY, Surface or GPU
    `-- Screen/PageList/Page remain public types despite their instance nesting
    Source: src/termio/Termio.zig:40-67; src/terminal/main.zig:38-64

ScreenSet: storage retained by Terminal.screens
|
|-- Public ScreenSet API: init/deinit, get/getInit, generation, remove, switchTo
|   `-- Retains active key/pointer, screen map and per-key generations
|
|-- Owned Screen instances (Screen is a separate public terminal type)
|   |-- Primary always initialized; alternate allocated lazily by getInit
|   |-- Public editing, selection and text-extraction operations
|   |-- Retains cursor/saved cursor, charset, protected mode and dirty flags
|   |-- Retains Kitty keyboard stack, optional images and semantic-prompt state
|   |-- selection: tracked Selection; select/clearSelection manage tracking
|   `-- pages: owned PageList instance
|       |-- Public resize, scroll, compress, pin/trackPin/untrackPin, iterators
|       |-- Retains viewport, tracked pins and MemoryPool (nodes/pages/pins)
|       |-- pages: public List type; ordered from scrollback to active screen
|       |   `-- Node: non-pub declaration, reachable through List.Node
|       |       |-- Retains serial, ownership provenance and storage union
|       |       |-- Resident Page or compressed page; virtual mapping retained
|       |       |-- page() restores compressed data; pageIfResident() does not
|       |       `-- Page instance (public type from sibling page.zig)
|       |           |-- Aligned contiguous memory; row and cell offsets
|       |           |-- Grapheme data, strings, style set and hyperlink tables
|       |           `-- Rows ordered; cell runs located through each row
|       `-- Private pool types and pin-set bookkeeping support storage lifecycle
|
`-- Boundaries
    |-- Nesting above denotes owned instances, not package ownership
    |-- -> Stream handler uses Terminal edits and Screen operations
    |-- -> Selection/search use pins; read models inspect screen/page state
    `-- -> Renderer schedules compression; PageList implements it

Stream decoding: persistent parser and handler composition
|
|-- Public Stream(Handler) generic (terminal/stream.zig)
|   |-- Public init/deinit, next/nextSlice/nextSliceUntil, ground, writeContinuation
|   |-- Owns handler value; deinit calls handler.deinit, not Terminal.deinit
|   |-- Retained parser: public Parser type from sibling Parser.zig
|   |   |-- Public next(byte) returns low-level Parser.Action values
|   |   `-- Internal state machine, parameter collection and OSC parser
|   |-- Retained UTF8Decoder: incomplete codepoints survive feed boundaries
|   |-- Optional continuation Tracker: bounded unfinished-sequence replay suffix
|   |   `-- Requires allocator and nonzero limit; supported only by TerminalStream
|   `-- -> Converts parser events into typed StreamAction calls on Handler.vt
|   Source: src/terminal/stream.zig:588-735,794,1371;
|           src/terminal/Parser.zig:14-80,257
|
|-- TerminalStream specialization = Stream(stream_terminal.Handler)
|   |-- Handler is pub in stream_terminal.zig; exposed via TerminalStream.Handler
|   |-- Public init/deinit, vt, resize; borrows terminal: *Terminal
|   |-- Retains APC/DCS handlers and clipboard grants/in-flight transaction
|   |-- Effects callback table
|   |   |-- Default readonly effects omit host responses and other side effects
|   |   `-- Optional write_pty, bell, title/pwd, clipboard and resize callbacks
|   |-- semantic_failure records unhandled semantic-update failures
|   `-- -> Edits Terminal modes/state and active Screen storage
|   Source: src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:31-113,166-338,504-523,609-618

`-- Construction and consumer boundary

    |-- Terminal.vtHandler returns a handler for caller-configured effects

    `-- termio instead uses Stream(StreamHandler) with application mailboxes
